name: Contoso International Airport
description: Synthetic airport near Redmond/Bellevue, Washington. Geographic placement does not describe any real airport, property, facilities or authorized operation.

scale.description: The lower east-west runway is assigned a synthetic length of 3000 m. The original sketch is not true to scale; this uniform calibration does not make aircraft, vehicle, human or indoor dimensions realistic.

source.curve_sampling: Cubic Bezier segments sampled at sixteen intervals per segment.
source.boundary_normalization: Space and zone polygons are clipped to their referenced level in exchange coordinates to keep shared boundaries consistent after projection.
source.precision_note: Coordinate decimal places preserve diagram alignment, not surveyed accuracy.

assumptions: Parking, car rental, approach roads, and source scale-marker examples are reference-only and excluded from modeled infrastructure.
Stand positions use aircraft-symbol bounding-box centers. They are not pavement boundaries, approved parking positions, clearance envelopes or aircraft capability evidence.
Gate positions use label locations projected to the terminal outline. Bridge associations are traced visually and require review.
The main building and curved pier outline come from vector paths; Bezier curves are approximated by polygon vertices.
All elevations, lower-level layouts, passenger zones, lane subdivisions and vertical connections are conceptual.
Main baggage reclaim has twelve user-specified carousels. Three customs carousels are an explicitly unconfirmed illustrative count.
No secure perimeter, real sanitization status, operational passenger access, complete route network, taxi routes or safety clearance is asserted.
A14, B39, B40, C1 and C8 remain gates without an inferred stand association.
